decisions.reason: The single-tube air cooled condenser builds directly on the firm's core heat-exchange knowledge, and its move to a dedicated page in 2024 shows growing commitment and an ability to learn from early market feedback.

Like B, this condenser sits squarely within the firm's existing expertise and was upgraded to its own page in 2024, so its early results are readable and it fits the efficiency and waste-heat direction.
The tube liner for corroded heat exchangers draws on the firm's long tube and repair know-how and supports its lifecycle service business, so it should be kept despite only modest website visibility.

The customized industrial air cooler line with several models closely fits the firm's strength in integrated custom solutions and its engineering base, so the firm can absorb customer feedback to improve it.
Tube end repair inserts are a low-cost service add-on that relies on existing maintenance competence and the global service network, which makes them easy to sustain and refine.
